facts_used: The Grand-Place-facing Gothic composition has an east wing, a shorter west wing and the tower between them.
The principal ground-floor facades are characterized by a projecting gallery/portico.
On either side of the portal below the tower, the ground-floor galleries have eleven bays on the left and six on the right.
The gallery openings are pointed arches; east and west galleries have documented but different support treatment.

decision_goal: Identify the exact camera-facing official WALLSURFACE IDs for the two Grand-Place-facing lower wing planes. Heritage semantics may nominate the gallery/portico as one later motif only after those source faces are proven.
